create_random_erasing_augmentation: create a RandomErasing transform with custom probability and area range for image data augmentation
apply_random_erasing_to_batch: apply RandomErasing to a batch of normalized image tensors using the callable interface
configure_erasing_pixel_mode: configure RandomErasing with pixel mode to use per-pixel random normal color for erased regions
use_random_erasing_cube_mode: use RandomErasing in cube mode to erase the same region across all images in a batch
generate_erasing_pixels: generate random or zero fill pixels for erasing patches using the _get_pixels helper function
